Signature Plantable Calendar – Eco-Friendly Seed Paper Desk Calendar

Our Signature Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly, 12 seed‐paper sheets (5″×7″); 6″×9″ wooden plate stand w/ rear support & front hook, tomato, basil & marigold seeds, Planting Instructions included is a premium sustainable gift designed for individuals and businesses looking to adopt mindful, planet-friendly gifting. Each month of this calendar is printed on high-quality biodegradable seed paper that grows into real plants when placed in soil. With a handcrafted wooden stand offering both durability and aesthetics, this eco-friendly calendar doubles as an elegant desk accessory and a zero-waste gifting choice.

Every sheet of this plantable seed paper calendar is embedded with a curated mix of tomato, basil, and marigold seeds, making each month a delightful opportunity to plant something new. Thoughtfully created for eco-conscious consumers, corporate offices, festive gifting, and green events, this unique desk calendar encourages a lifestyle rooted in sustainability. Each pack comes with simple, easy-to-follow planting instructions, ensuring anyone can grow plants successfully at home or in the workplace.

Why Choose Our?

This is crafted with sustainable materials, offering an impressive combination of utility, design, and environmental responsibility. The 12 monthly sheets (5″×7″) are made using tree-free seed paper designed to sprout when planted. Whether you are searching for innovative green gifting ideas or a memorable sustainable corporate gift, this plantable calendar stands out due to its eco appeal and handcrafted wooden stand measuring 6″×9″ with rear support and a front hook for easy display.

The addition of tomato, basil, and marigold seeds makes the calendar exciting for gardening enthusiasts, office teams, schools, and CSR gifting programs. The included planting instructions are simple enough for beginners while offering the joy of watching seeds grow into healthy plants. This blend of utility and sustainability makes the plantable seed a perfect choice for environmentally responsible individuals and brands.

Key Features

  • Signature Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly with 12 premium seed paper sheets (5″×7″)
  • Handcrafted 6″×9″ wooden plate stand with rear support & front hook
  • Includes tomato, basil & marigold seeds embedded in each sheet
  • Complete planting instructions included for easy seed germination
  • 100% biodegradable & tree-free seed paper
  • Ideal for sustainable corporate gifting and eco-friendly events
  • Perfect for home desks, office tables, festive gifts & brand promotions
  • Zero-waste design that grows into plants instead of generating trash

Perfect for Corporate & Green Gifting

This option is widely preferred by brands embracing sustainability. Companies choose this plantable desk calendar for employee welcome kits, client gifting, trade shows, year-end gifts, and eco-initiatives. With rising interest in green lifestyle products and biodegradable calendars, this seed-paper aligns perfectly with CSR and environmentally responsible branding.

The handcrafted wooden stand adds an artisanal touch, ensuring durability while complementing modern office décor. Since each month can be planted after use, the product supports mindful living and reduces paper waste. As search trends show strong demand for seed paper products, and sustainable desk accessories, this category page content is optimized to help your website rank higher and attract customers actively looking for green gifting solutions.

How to Use & Plant

Simply place the monthly seed paper sheet in soil, water it gently, and keep it in natural sunlight. Within days, the embedded tomato, basil & marigold seeds begin to sprout, transforming your calendar into a growing garden. The included planting instructions guide beginners through each step, ensuring a smooth and joyful gardening experience.
